name: data_agent_instructions_tool
title: Data Agent Instructions Tool
description: Data tool - Manage agent instructions (rules and skills) for a site. Actions: search_instructions, read_instruction, create_instruction, update_instruction, delete_instruction, move_instruction. Paths must follow 'rules/<name>.md', 'rules/<name>.mdc', or '<skill-name>/SKILL.md'.

path.description: Storage path. For rule: 'rules/<name>.md' or 'rules/<nested>/<name>.mdc'. For skill: '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}'.

create_instruction.description: Create a new agent instruction (rule or skill). `kind` selects the grammar used to validate `path`. Rule paths look like 'rules/<segments>.{md|mdc}' (nested folders allowed). Skill paths look like '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' (skill root) or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}' (skill companion file); <skill-name> must be lowercase kebab-case. Always writes version=0; use update_instruction to modify an existing instruction. Control characters in markdown (except tab/LF/CR) are normalized to spaces.

path.description: Storage path to delete. For rule: 'rules/<name>.md' or 'rules/<nested>/<name>.mdc'. For skill: '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' (deletes the whole skill) or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}' (deletes a single companion file).

delete_instruction.description: Delete an existing agent instruction (rule, skill, or skill companion file) by path. Deleting a skill's 'SKILL.md' cascades to all descendants. Idempotent. `kind` selects the grammar used to validate `path` (same grammar as create_instruction / update_instruction).

fromPath.description: Current storage path to rename. For rule: 'rules/<name>.md' or 'rules/<nested>/<name>.mdc'. For skill: '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' (renames the whole skill, cascading to all descendants), a companion file '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}', or a subfolder path (cascades).

toPath.description: New storage path. Must keep the same parent folder.

move_instruction.description: Rename an existing agent instruction (rule, skill, companion file, or subfolder) by path. Renaming a skill's 'SKILL.md' or a subfolder cascades to all descendants.

resolve_references.description: If true (default), referenced instructions are resolved and inlined into the returned markdown body. Set to false to read the raw source.

read_instruction.description: Read a single agent instruction by path. Path must be 'rules/<name>.{md|mdc}', '<skill-name>/SKILL.md', or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}'.

name.description: Optional filename query for narrowing instruction search.

description.description: Optional description query for narrowing instruction search.

markdown.description: Optional markdown content query for narrowing instruction search.

limit.description: Maximum number of instructions to return (default 100).

offset.description: Number of matching instructions to skip (default 0).

search_instructions.description: Search agent instructions (rules and skills) stored on a site. Optional name/description/markdown filters apply case-insensitive substring matching. Returns instruction metadata and pagination plus a `resourceUri` for each result; use that URI with the agent_instruction resource (or read_instruction) to fetch the full markdown body.

path.description: Storage path of the existing instruction. For rule: 'rules/<name>.md' or 'rules/<nested>/<name>.mdc'. For skill: '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}'.

markdown.description: New markdown body. Omit to keep current. Max 256 KB; control chars (except tab/LF/CR) are stripped to spaces.

description.description: New description. Omit to keep current. Pass an empty string to clear.

isDraft.description: New draft flag. Omit to keep current.

update_instruction.description: Update an existing agent instruction. Fetches the current source (with references unresolved), applies the provided overrides, and writes back; the server resolves the latest version automatically. Pass only the fields you want to change — omitted fields keep their current values. Use create_instruction for a brand new path. Control characters in markdown (except tab/LF/CR) are normalized to spaces.

actions.description: Executed sequentially. Each item must include label and exactly one action property.

context.description: Explain why this tool is being called and how it fits the user's goal, in 15-25 words, third person (no 'I'/'we'/'you'). Used for analytics only. Never include credentials or personal data.

label.description: Echoed in the response; does not select which action runs.

site_id.description: The site ID.

kind.description: Selects validation rules for `path`: 'rule' expects 'rules/<segments>.{md|mdc}'; 'skill' expects '<skill-name>/SKILL.md' or '<skill-name>/<subfolder>/<file>.{md|mdc}' (skill companion file).

markdown.description: Markdown body. Max 256 KB; control chars (except tab/LF/CR) are stripped to spaces.

isDraft.description: If true, save as a draft.

name: data_analyze_tool
title: Data Analyze Tool
description: Read Webflow Analyze report data for a site, including traffic timeseries, ranked pages, ranked dimensions, ranked engagement events, and aggregate or bucketed time on page. Includes guide actions for building Analyze queries and resolving engagement event rows to page elements, component instances, and CMS context.

get_query_guide.description: Returns static guidance for constructing data_analyze_tool queries — how to resolve site IDs, date ranges, page path, CMS collection/item, and dimension filter values from other tools before filtering. Takes no arguments and makes no API calls. The same guidance is available as the MCP resource webflow://guides/analyze-query.

get_resolve_event_element_guide.description: Returns static guidance for connecting get_top_events_report rows with the Webflow elements, component instances, and CMS content behind those events. Takes no arguments and makes no API calls. The same guidance is available as the MCP resource webflow://guides/resolve-event-element.

metricScope.description: Which metric to base time-on-page on: 'session', 'user', or 'pageview'.

granularityPeriod.description: Bucket size for a time_on_page timeseries. Use 'day' for daily buckets or 'week' for weekly buckets.

timeseries.description: Optional timeseries options. When provided, returns bucketed average time data using the supplied granularity and IANA time zone. Omit for one aggregate value over the window.

get_time_on_page_report.description: Get the average time visitors spend on the site or a specific page. Omit timeseries for an aggregate value over the window; provide timeseries for a daily or weekly trend.

dimension.description: The dimension to rank top values for.

metricScope.description: Which metric to count: 'session' or 'user'. Pageview is not supported for top_dimensions.

limit.description: Maximum number of dimension values to return.

get_top_dimensions_report.description: Get the top values for a single dimension (e.g. country, browser, utmSource) on a site, ranked by session or user count.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (1..250).

get_top_events_report.description: Get the top engagement events on a site ranked by frequency, with page context, over a given window. Events are implicitly ranked by frequency (no metricScope or sortBy).

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return. A public cap is enforced by the API.

sortBy.description: Metric to sort the top pages by.

timeseries.description: Optional timeseries options. When provided, each row includes a daily pageview timeseries bucketed in the supplied IANA time zone.

get_top_pages_report.description: Get the top pages on a site ranked by session, user, or pageview count over a given window.

get_traffic_report.description: Get a time-series of session, user, or pageview counts for a site over a given window.

actions.description: Executed sequentially. Each item must include label and exactly one action property.

context.description: Explain why this tool is being called and how it fits the user's goal, in 15-25 words, third person (no 'I'/'we'/'you'). Used for analytics only. Never include credentials or personal data.

label.description: Echoed in the response; does not select which action runs.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 datetime as a UTC timestamp ending in Z, for example 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z. Numeric offsets such as -04:00 or +00:00 are not accepted. Must be on or after 2025-04-09T00:00:00.000Z. The range from startTime to endTime must not exceed 100 days.

endTime.description: ISO 8601 datetime as a UTC timestamp ending in Z, for example 2026-04-08T00:00:00Z. Numeric offsets such as -04:00 or +00:00 are not accepted. Must be greater than startTime. The range from startTime to endTime must not exceed 100 days.

deviceType.description: Filter results to a single device type.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (2 letters). Auto-uppercased by the API.

pagePath.description: Filter results to a single page path.

trafficSource.description: Filter results to a single traffic source.

browser.description: Filter results to a single browser.

utmCampaign.description: Filter results to a single utm_campaign value.

utmMedium.description: Filter results to a single utm_medium value.

utmSource.description: Filter results to a single utm_source value.

referrer.description: Filter results to a single referrer.

eq.description: Match rows where the dimension equals this value.

ne.description: Exclude rows where the dimension equals this value.

in.description: Match rows where the dimension is any of these values (1-50 items).

nin.description: Exclude rows where the dimension is any of these values (1-50 items).

filter.description: Optional general-purpose filter. Each key is a dimension name and each value is an operator object with optional eq/ne/in/nin (in/nin arrays must have 1-50 items). Allowed dimensions: country, region, deviceType, deviceBrand, os, browser, language, locale, referrer, trafficSource, domain, timezone, pageId, pagePath, collectionId, itemSlug, visitStatus, dayOfWeek, timeOfDay, previousPageId, nextPageId, previousCollectionId, nextCollectionId, previousItemSlug, nextItemSlug, utmCampaign, utmContent, utmMedium, utmSource, utmTerm, audienceIds. Unknown dimensions are rejected by the API.

bucketTimeZone.description: Valid IANA time zone used to align time bucket boundaries, such as UTC or America/New_York. Bucket timestamps are returned as UTC instants for local bucket starts in this time zone.

timeseries.description: Optional timeseries options. When provided, each row includes a daily event-count timeseries bucketed in the supplied IANA time zone.

fieldData.description: Item field data keyed by collection field slug (use get_collection to discover fields); 'name' and 'slug' are optional for updates.

name: data_localization_tool
title: Data Localization Tool
description: Data tool for localizing pages and components into secondary locales. Read and update static page content, component content, and component property overrides for any non-primary locale. Writes target secondary locales only — the primary (default) locale cannot be edited through this tool. Also includes list_components for discovering component IDs to localize.

get_component_content.description: Read component content (text, images, nested components) for a given locale. Pass localeId to read a secondary locale; omit it to read the primary locale's content.

get_component_properties.description: Read component property definitions and current values for a given locale. Pass localeId to read overrides for a secondary locale.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned (max limit: 100)

offset.description: Offset used for pagination if the results have more than limit records.

get_page_content.description: Read a page's content structure for a given locale. Pass localeId to read a secondary locale; omit it for the primary locale.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Site.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned (max limit: 100)

offset.description: Offset used for pagination if the results have more than limit records.

list_components.description: List all components in a site. Returns component metadata including IDs, names, and versions.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Site.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

text.description: HTML content of the node, including the HTML tag.
Value used to override a component property.

propertyOverrides.description: Properties to override for this locale's component instances.

anyOf.description: Update text property overrides of a component instance.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

text.description: New value for the property in this locale.

properties.description: Array of properties to update for this component.

update_component_properties.description: Localize component property values into a secondary locale. Requires localeId — only secondary locales can be edited. The primary locale's property values are not editable through this action.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

text.description: HTML content of the node, including the HTML tag. The HTML tags must be the same as what’s returned from the Get Content endpoint.
Value used to override a component property; must be type-compatible to prevent errors.

name: data_pages_tool
title: Data Pages Tool
description: Data tool - Pages tool to perform actions like list pages, get page metadata, update page settings, create a page, bulk update page settings, manage branches and their staging previews, and read or write JSON-LD schema markup for pages in bulk.

id.description: ID of the page to update.

bulk_update_pages.description: Update settings for 1..100 pages of a site in one request (writes to existing pages). Each item targets a page by id and may set any subset of: localeId (write to a secondary locale), title, slug, draft, parentFolderId, seo, openGraph, and jsonLdSchema.

jsonLdSchema.description: JSON-LD structured data as an object, a raw JSON string, or null to clear existing markup.

bulk_update_pages_schema_markup.description: Write or clear JSON-LD schema markup for one or more pages (1..25). Pass a 1-item array for a single page. Per item: id (required), optional localeId, and jsonLdSchema. Strings wrapped in <script type="application/ld+json">…</script> are accepted.

create_branch.description: Enqueue an async task to create a branch from a page on a site.

slug.description: URL slug for the page (the path segment).

parentFolderId.description: ID of the folder to nest the page under. Omit to create the page at the site root.

draft.description: Whether the page is a draft (excluded from publishing). Defaults to false when omitted.

duplicateOf.description: ID of an existing page in the same site to duplicate.

create_page.description: Create a new page in a site. title and slug are required; optionally nest it under a folder (parentFolderId), mark it as a draft, duplicate an existing page (duplicateOf), and set seo and openGraph metadata.

delete_branch.description: Enqueue an async task to delete a branch from a site.

get_branch_conflicts.description: Read-only: list a branch's unresolved conflicts with the site's main pages (no merge attempted). Returns { conflicts }, each { id, name, type: "style" | "component", updatedAt?, updatedBy? }; id is not always an ObjectId (e.g. "default-body"); updatedAt/updatedBy appear on style conflicts only. Each entry maps 1:1 to a resolutions[] item for update_branch or merge_branch. Computed against the last synced state — re-check after very recent branch edits; an empty array usually means update/merge needs no resolutions. 404 branch_not_found.

limit.description: Max records to return (up to 100).

offset.description: Pagination offset.

get_branch_details.description: Get detailed information about a branch.

task_id.description: Async branch task ID (a UUID, not an ObjectId).

get_branch_task_status.description: Poll the status of an async branch task, using the taskId from the mutation's response, until "finished" or "failed". Returns { taskId, status, taskType, branchId, siteId, createdOn, error?, nextActions }; status: "queued" | "started" | "finished" | "failed"; taskType: "branch_create" | "branch_delete" | "branch_merge" | "branch_publish" | "branch_update". branchId is null until a create task finishes; on "failed", read error.message and error.code. 404 branch_task_not_found for an unknown task ID, a non-branch task, or a task from a different site.

get_page_metadata.description: Get a page's metadata: SEO, Open Graph, and draft/published status.

limit.description: Max branches to return (up to 100).

offset.description: Pagination offset.

list_branches.description: List a site's branches, with pagination.

limit.description: Max records to return (up to 100).

offset.description: Pagination offset.

list_pages.description: List a site's pages: IDs, titles, and slugs.

merge_branch.description: Enqueue an async task that merges a branch INTO the site's main pages (branch -> main); on success the branch is consumed and disappears from list_branches. Returns { taskId, status: "queued", nextActions } — poll get_branch_task_status (taskType "branch_merge"). If the branch conflicts, pass resolutions covering every conflict: list them via get_branch_conflicts, or omit resolutions to get code "branch_merge_conflict" with conflicts[] inline and retry. Unresolved conflicts surface as a failed task. 409 branch_merge_in_progress if a merge is already running for the site; 404 branch_not_found.

publish_branch.description: Enqueue an async task that publishes ONLY the branch's page preview to its configured staging domain — production domains are not published and nothing is merged. Returns { taskId, status: "queued", stagingDomain, publishedOn, nextActions }; publishedOn is the trigger time, not completion — poll get_branch_task_status (taskType "branch_publish"). 409 branch_publish_failed if no staging domain is configured; 404 branch_not_found. The staging domain also appears on list_branches and get_branch_details.

query_pages_schema_markup.description: Read JSON-LD schema markup for one or more pages (1..100). Pass a 1-item array for a single page.

update_branch.description: Enqueue an async task that pulls the latest main-page changes INTO a branch (main -> branch); it does NOT merge the branch back to main. Returns { taskId, status: "queued", nextActions } — poll get_branch_task_status (taskType "branch_update"). If the branch conflicts, pass resolutions covering every conflict (list them via get_branch_conflicts); 400 invalid_resolution means they do not cover the full set. 409 branch_update_in_progress if an update is already running; 404 branch_not_found.

page_id.description: Unique identifier for the page to update.

update_page_settings.description: Update settings for a single page (writes to an existing page). Accepts any subset of: title, slug, draft, parentFolderId, seo, openGraph, and jsonLdSchema. Pass localeId to write to a secondary locale; omit it for the primary locale.

actions.description: Executed sequentially. Each item must include label and exactly one action property.

context.description: Explain why this tool is being called and how it fits the user's goal, in 15-25 words, third person (no 'I'/'we'/'you'). Used for analytics only. Never include credentials or personal data.

label.description: Echoed in the response; does not select which action runs.

site_id.description: Webflow site ID. Use list_sites to discover site IDs.

localeId.description: Secondary locale ID. Omit for the primary locale.

titleCopied.description: Whether the Open Graph title is copied from the SEO/page title.

descriptionCopied.description: Whether the Open Graph description is copied from the SEO/page description.

imageUrl.description: Open Graph image URL (og:image); null unsets it. Mutually exclusive with imageAssetId.

imageAssetId.description: Site asset ID for the Open Graph image; null unsets it. Mutually exclusive with imageUrl.

openGraph.description: Open Graph metadata for the page.

branch_id.description: Branch ID. Use list_branches to discover branch IDs.

localeId2.description: Locale ID to read, when using localization.

id.description: Identifier of the conflicting style or component, as returned by get_branch_conflicts or merge_branch's branch_merge_conflict conflicts[] (not always an ObjectId).

resolution.description: Which side wins for this conflict: "main" keeps the main version, "branch" keeps the branch version.

resolutions.description: Conflict resolutions; required when the branch conflicts with main. For merge_branch, omitting on the first attempt returns branch_merge_conflict with conflicts[] inline.

slug.description: URL slug for the page (the path segment).

draft.description: Whether the page is a draft (excluded from publishing).

parentFolderId.description: ID of the folder to nest the page under. null moves the page to the site root.

jsonLdSchema.description: JSON-LD structured data as a raw string. null clears the page's existing JSON-LD schema markup.

name: data_scripts_tool
title: Data Scripts Tool
description: Data tool - Scripts tool to manage custom code scripts. Register, apply, update, and remove scripts at the site or page level, and read or write freeform head/footer custom code blocks.

add_page_script.description: Apply a single registered script to a page without affecting other applied scripts (register one first with register_inline_script or register_hosted_script). If the script ID is already applied, its location, version, and attributes are updated.

add_site_script.description: Apply a single registered script to a site without affecting other applied scripts (register one first with register_inline_script or register_hosted_script). If the script ID is already applied, its location, version, and attributes are updated.

clear_page_scripts.description: Remove all scripts applied to a page. The scripts stay registered on the site and can be re-applied with add_page_script or set_page_scripts.

clear_site_scripts.description: Remove all scripts applied to a site. The scripts stay registered on the site and can be re-applied with add_site_script or set_site_scripts.

script_id.description: The registered script ID to delete.

delete_registered_script.description: Delete a registered script and all of its versions from a site. Destructive and irreversible.

get_page_freeform_code.description: Read the freeform head/footer custom code blocks on a page.

get_page_scripts.description: Get all scripts currently applied to a page, with their IDs, locations (header/footer), versions, and attributes.

version.description: Optional SemVer version string. When omitted, returns the most recently created version.

get_registered_script.description: Get a single registered script for a site by script ID. Returns its metadata: ID, display name, version, and hosting information.

get_registered_scripts.description: List all scripts registered for a site (up to 800 per site), with script IDs, display names, versions, and hosting information. Apply them with add_site_script or add_page_script.

get_site_freeform_code.description: Read the freeform head/footer custom code blocks on a site. These are raw code blocks, distinct from registered scripts.

get_site_scripts.description: Get all scripts currently applied to a site, with their IDs, locations (header/footer), versions, and attributes.

site_id.description: The site ID to register the script for.

hosted_location.description: URI of the externally hosted script.

integrity_hash.description: Sub-Resource Integrity (SRI) hash for the hosted script.

register_hosted_script.description: Register an externally hosted script for a site without applying it anywhere. Returns the registered script's metadata, including its ID; apply it with add_site_script or add_page_script.

site_id.description: The site ID to register the script for.

source_code.description: Inline script source code hosted by Webflow. Max 2000 characters.

register_inline_script.description: Register an inline script for a site without applying it anywhere. Returns the registered script's metadata, including its ID; apply it with add_site_script or add_page_script.

script_id.description: ID of the script to remove from the page.

remove_page_script.description: Remove a single script from a page without affecting other applied scripts. If the script is not applied, the current list is returned unchanged; removing the last one clears all scripts from the page.

script_id.description: ID of the script to remove from the site.

remove_site_script.description: Remove a single script from a site without affecting other applied scripts. If the script is not applied, the current list is returned unchanged; removing the last one clears all scripts from the site.

siteId.description: Webflow site ID. Discover with list_sites.

pageId.description: Any valid page id that exists in the site

build_label.description: A label to identify this build action in the results.

component.description: The component id of the element to perform action on.

creation_position.description: The position to create element on. append/prepend insert as child of the parent element. before/after insert as sibling adjacent to the target element.

type.description: The type of element to create. Use DOM for a generic DOM element (requires set_dom_config). Use BY_CUSTOM_TAG to create any element by arbitrary HTML tag with optional atomic settings (requires custom_tag).

style_names.description: The style names to set on the element.

set_style.description: Set style on the element. it will remove all other styles on the element. and set only the styles passed in style_names.

text.description: The text to set on the element.

link_type.description: The type of link to set on the element.

link.description: The link to set on the element.

set_link.description: Set link on the element. only valid for button, text link, link block.

heading_level.description: The heading level to set on the element.

image_asset_id.description: The image asset id to set on the element.

alt_text.description: The alt text to set on the image. if not provided it will inherit from the image asset.

set_image_asset.description: Set image asset on the element. only valid for image.

dom_tag.description: The tag of the DOM element to create. for example span, code, etc.

set_dom_config.description: Set DOM config on the element. only valid for DOM element.

custom_tag.description: HTML tag name for the new element (e.g. 'div', 'span', 'p', 'h1'). Required when type is BY_CUSTOM_TAG.

name.description: The name of the attribute to set.

value.description: The value of the attribute to set.

attributes.description: The attributes to set on the element.

key.description: The setting key to write (e.g. "domId", "altText", "href", "visibility", "attributes"). Use get_settings to discover keys.

clear.description: Resets the setting to its default (writes null).

value.description: For keys producing string / textContent / id / altText / image (asset ID).

to.description: Link target. url/email/phone: literal value; page: pageId; file: assetId; collectionPage: pageSlug; pageSection: unused — use to_element_id.

to_element_id.description: Link target element. Only used when mode is "pageSection".

value_binding.description: Bind the attribute value to a typed data source.

items.description: Exactly one of name_static / name_binding must be set; exactly one of value_static / value_binding must be set.

attributes.description: Only valid when key is "attributes". Replaces the full attribute list; an empty array removes all.

items.description: One setting write. Exactly one of clear / binding / static_text / static_number / static_boolean / static_link / static_video / attributes / static_json must be provided.

settings.description: Settings to apply atomically on element creation (e.g. domId, altText, visibility). Same format as set_settings. If any setting is invalid the element is not created. Only applies to DOM type elements.
